claims.evidence: Visual inspection cannot distinguish between a recently imported engine and a well-cleaned locally used one without shipping documents or internal inspection.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical failure (e.g., seized, blown head gasket)
risks.proof: A video of a compression test or the engine running.
Video of the gear selector moving through positions and inspection of transmission fluid color/smell.
Clear photo of the engine code stamped on the block and the VIN of the donor vehicle.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine model code and serial number stamped on the block.
Photos of the ECU and wiring harness connectors to check for cuts or damage.
Video of the crankshaft being turned manually to ensure it is not seized.
Documentation or port clearance papers to support 'Tokunbo' status.
response.reason: The witness report identifies the item generally as an engine and transmission but provides no make, model, or serial number, making it impossible to assign a value.
